milestone: First shared-backbone architecture and host runtime prototype

architecture.shared_body: Pinned pretrained Urban Nano backbone and neck, one pass per model forward
architecture.detection_and_projected_corner_branch: Pretrained Urban one-to-one branch; COCO-80 weights retained, product scores 0/2/5/7 exported
architecture.depth_branch: New 64-channel separable multi-scale decoder, stride4 positive log-depth output; untrained

host_profile.scope: Host ORT session.run including fetching both outputs, not preprocessing, candidate decoding, camera or rendering; NOT iPhone latency

limitations: New depth head is untrained; its numeric outputs cannot be used as distances
Synthetic fixtures establish execution/parity only, not detection, depth or cuboid accuracy
New 640x384 input and product-only candidate selection are not accuracy-qualified against the installed app
Pretrained COCO-80 class branch remains internally; this is not yet a two-class fine-tuned model
Only the new depth head is trainable in this initial stage; joint GT fine-tuning and teacher distillation have not started
Camera-OFF iPhone runtime adapter/benchmark is still the next step; the existing phone app is unchanged
Urban and Ultralytics upstream license terms continue to apply
next_step: Add a separately labelled camera-OFF iPhone runtime screen; only consider GT depth-head training after phone feasibility checks
